subtitle: Out Manila · Philippine Airlines
overview: Fly direct to Xiamen with Philippine Airlines and start with the Tianluokeng earthen building cluster (tulou). Then follow the Chaoshan coast through Chaozhou’s old city, Shantou and Nan’ao Island with its Tropic of Cancer landmark, and finish in Xiamen with Gulangyu Island. Six nights in 4-star hotels with a private bus and English-speaking guide.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 26–Dec 2 2026 to Mar 20–26 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Xiamen – Nanjing
items: Meet the tour guide at Xiamen airport
After lunch, drive to Nanjing and visit the Tianluokeng Earthen Building Cluster

itinerary.title: Nanjing – Chaozhou
items: Tea and a Yingge Dance performance at the Old Teahouse
Guangji Bridge Light and Shadow Show (complimentary, no refund if cancelled)

itinerary.title: Chaozhou – Shantou – Nan’ao
items: Thai Buddha Hall, a popular Nanyang-style photo spot
Drive to Shantou: Former Residence of Chen Cihong (filming location of Dear You)
Cross Nan’ao Bridge to Nan’ao Island

itinerary.title: Nan’ao – Shantou
items: Gate of Nature, Tropic of Cancer landmark
Drive to Shantou, free time at Longyan South Road Food Street

itinerary.title: Shantou
items: Chaoshan History and Culture Expo Center
Neihai Bay ferry, with views along both sides of the bay

itinerary.title: Xiamen – Manila
items: Transfer to the airport and fly home (PR331, 17:40–20:30)

placeDesc.Tianluokeng Earthen Building Cluster: A group of round and square earthen tulou houses in Fujian, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
placeDesc.Guangji Bridge: A historic bridge over the Han River in Chaozhou, with a complimentary light and shadow show in the evening.
placeDesc.Chaozhou Ancient City: A walled old city in eastern Guangdong famous for its heritage streets and Chaozhou culture.
placeDesc.Paifang Street: A street in Chaozhou Ancient City lined with traditional stone memorial archways.
placeDesc.Kaiyuan Temple: A Buddhist temple in Chaozhou that dates back more than a thousand years.
placeDesc.Thai Buddha Hall: A Thai-style Buddhist hall in Chaozhou, a popular Nanyang-style photo spot.
placeDesc.West Lake Park: A lakeside park in Chaozhou with gardens and walking paths.
placeDesc.Chen Cihong Former Residence: A historic home in Shantou that was used as a filming location for the series Dear You.
placeDesc.Nan’ao Island: A seaside island off Shantou, reached by crossing the Nan’ao Bridge, with coastal views.
placeDesc.Qihang Square: A seaside square on Nan’ao Island, visited for its waterfront views.
placeDesc.Changshanwei Lighthouse: A coastal lighthouse on Nan’ao Island, visited as a scenic stop.
placeDesc.Rainbow Sea: A colourful stretch of coast on Nan’ao Island known for oyster farms; oyster harvesting not included.
placeDesc.Qing’ao Bay: A scenic bay on Nan’ao Island visited on the coastal tour.
placeDesc.Tropic of Cancer Landmark: The Gate of Nature landmark on Nan’ao Island marking the Tropic of Cancer.
placeDesc.Nanshan Temple: A temple on Nan’ao Island visited during the island tour.
placeDesc.Neihai Bay: A bay in Shantou crossed by ferry, with views of the city on both sides.
placeDesc.Qiaopi Museum: A museum in Shantou about qiaopi, the remittance letters sent home by overseas Chinese.
placeDesc.Gulangyu Island: A car-free island off Xiamen with colonial-era buildings, a UNESCO World Heritage site, reached by ferry.
placeDesc.Zhongshan Road: Xiamen's main pedestrian shopping street, with free time for food and shopping.
